rules.message: PowerShell 5.1 Parser Error: Use separate tool calls, not && or ||. See AGENTS.md §PowerShell Environment Rules.
Unix/CMD syntax detected. Use PowerShell equivalents: dir, Get-Content, Select-String, Get-ChildItem, 2>$null. See AGENTS.md §NEVER USE THESE PATTERNS.
Git Bash paths forbidden. Use Windows paths: C:\\Users\\... or relative paths. See AGENTS.md §Path Formats.

rules.description: Block Python command chaining in PowerShell
rules.message: Python chaining fails in PowerShell 5.1. Use 'Write then Execute' pattern: write script file, then run it. See AGENTS.md §Python Execution in PowerShell 5.1.

rules.description: Use glob tool for file discovery, not find/dir
rules.message: Use glob tool for file discovery. bash find/dir is for verified commands only.

rules.description: Use read tool for directory listing
rules.message: Use read tool on directory path for clean, token-efficient listing.

rules.description: Use grep tool for content search
rules.message: Use grep tool for content search when available.
Broad directory dumps forbidden. Use glob with specific pattern or read on directory.

rules.description: Must read file after edit/write to verify
rules.message: VERIFICATION REQUIRED: After edit/write, you MUST read the file to verify the change. See AGENTS.md §VERIFICATION PROTOCOL.

rules.description: Must check exit code after bash command
rules.message: Check exit code after commands. Non-zero = diagnose before retry. See AGENTS.md §VERIFICATION PROTOCOL.

rules.description: Block claims of completion without evidence
rules.message: FALSE COMPLETION CLAIM: You claimed completion without verification evidence. Per AGENTS.md §15 Evidence Policy: 'Never claim that a file was read, modified, tested, committed, deployed, or verified unless the corresponding action and result are supported by available evidence.' Provide tool call evidence or retract.
RETRY BUDGET EXCEEDED: Same command failed twice. STOP. Change approach per AGENTS.md: 'Same command with same syntax: 1 retry (then change approach)'.
RETRY BUDGET EXCEEDED: 3 syntax variations failed. Switch tools per AGENTS.md.
Retries exhausted. You MUST: 1) State clearly what failed, 2) Switch to fundamentally different tool/method, 3) Report limitation. See AGENTS.md §Escalation Protocol.

rules.description: Enforce two-strike rule for tool failures
rules.message: TWO-STRIKE RULE: Same error type twice. You MUST pivot to fundamentally different tool. Do not attempt 3rd variation. See AGENTS.md §1.
CONTEXT MANAGEMENT: Before next tool call, summarize 'Known/Unknown/Next' in reasoning. See AGENTS.md §4.
OUTPUT COMPRESSION: Do not paste verbose outputs. Summarize in 2-3 sentences. See AGENTS.md §OUTPUT COMPRESSION.

triggers: file not found after multiple paths
rules.message: EARLY EXIT: Stop investigating. State: 'Investigation of X yielded no results because Y. Moving to Z.' See AGENTS.md §EARLY EXIT.
TASK DECOMPOSITION REQUIRED: Create todo list before multi-step work. Use todowrite. See AGENTS.md §TASK DECOMPOSITION.

rules.description: One atomic operation per tool call
rules.message: ATOMIC OPERATIONS: One operation per call. Read → Edit → Verify as separate calls. See AGENTS.md §Atomic Operations.

FABRICATION DETECTED: You referenced tool output/logs/tests that weren't actually executed. Per AGENTS.md §11: 'Do not fabricate evidence, logs, citations, tool results, timestamps, or test outcomes.'
EVIDENCE POLICY: Distinguish explicitly: Requested vs Attempted vs Happened vs Verified vs Unknown. See AGENTS.md §15.3.

rules.description: Block substituting plausible explanations for unknown causes
rules.message: SPECULATION BLOCKED: Cause not established from evidence. Say: 'I cannot determine the cause from the available evidence.' See AGENTS.md §15.6.
PATH FORMAT: Use C:\\Users\\... or relative paths. No Git Bash or forward-slash paths. See AGENTS.md §Path Format Rules.

rules.description: Don't cd in bash - use workdir parameter
rules.message: The bash tool's workdir parameter handles paths. Don't cd inside commands.
Use feature branch + PR. Main is protected.

rules.description: AGENTS.md must be read before tool use
rules.message: AGENTS.md must be read first. Use read tool on AGENTS.md.

rules.description: Require descriptive label for git stash push
rules.message: Stash requires descriptive label. Use 'git stash push -m "description_of_work"'. See AGENTS.md §Git & Repository Management Hygiene.

rules.description: Require submodule audit before git merge
rules.message: Repository has submodules. Run 'git submodule status' and 'git submodule update --init --recursive' before merging. See AGENTS.md §Git & Repository Management Hygiene.

rules.description: Block direct push to protected branches
rules.message: Direct push to protected branch (main/develop). Use PR flow: push feature branch, then 'gh pr create'. See AGENTS.md §5 and constitution 11-GIT-STANDARDS.md.
